title.en: Building Control (Exempt Fixed Installations and Fixed Installation Works) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Building Control (Exempt Fixed Installations and Fixed Installation Works) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 October 2025.
2. In this Order, “specified fixed installation” means any fixed installation specified in the Schedule.
3. The Act and the building regulations do not apply to any specified fixed installation.

4. The Act and the building regulations do not apply to any fixed installation works —
(a)for the installation of a specified fixed installation; or
(b)that are carried out in relation to a specified fixed installation.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Specified fixed installations
1.A stage or orchestra lift.
2.A lift that is used solely to carry out building works.
3.A lift that is not attached to any building and is designed to be used by a person to carry out works.
4.A lifting platform that is designed to be used to raise or lower a person who is carrying out works, such as a mast climbing work platform, building maintenance unit, suspended scaffold or mobile elevating work platform.
5.A lift that is used as part of an amusement ride (within the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Amusement Rides Safety Act 2011).
6.A stairlift or vertical platform lift that —
(a)has a maximum vertical displacement of less than 1,000 millimetres during operation;
(b)exerts a maximum downward force of less than 150 Newtons when the lift moves downwards; and
(c)serves a single residential unit.
7.A lift installed in any ship or aircraft.
8.A lifting device that does not move along any guide or guides.
